			tu_dw_free_text_11_visible = { NOT = { NOT = { country_exists = YYU } } NOT = { YYU = { has_country_flag = TU_YAN_fac_freed } } NOT = { YYU = { is_subject_of = YAN } } NOT = { YYU = { has_war_with = YAN } } always = yes }
		}
	}

	TU_LANDSHIP_panel = {
		context_type = decision_category
		window_name = "TU_LANDSHIP_panel_window"
		visible = {
			has_tech = tu_landship_1
		}
		triggers = {

			tu_seg_0_4_visible = { check_variable = { TU_landships > 4.999 } }

		}
